list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(paper-trade): improve order management & risk
- Update risk calculation to use percentage - Fix stop loss / take profit calcs - Remove redundant order req handling
Updates risk management calculations to be based on percentage of balance and fixes calculation errors with stop loss and take profit levels. Cleans up order request logic by removing redundant handling. Also allows TestStrat use.

changelist.comment:
feat(geneticAlgorithm): Save logbook to file
The logbook saving logic was duplicated.
- Introduce a static method `_save_logbook` to save the logbook. - Remove duplicated code in the `run` method. - Call the `_save_logbook` method at the end of `run`.

task.summary:
feat(binanceApi): enhance historical data fetching
- Fix: Correctly format start and end times for file paths to avoid errors. - Change: Modify the end parameter of print from "\r" to "\n" to enable progress display in IDEs. - Update: Change the default interval to "1h"
Improves data retrieval and progress reporting.

fix(binanceApi): improve data fetching progress display
Refactor print statement to use carriage return.
- Update print to overwrite the previous line. - Improves user experience.

feat(geneticAlgorithm): remove hardcoded parameters
- Remove hardcoded bt_settings from GeneticAlgorithm init - Add extensive logging of GA runs and top individuals for analysis - Improve code readability
The hardcoded parameters limited the flexibility of the GeneticAlgorithm. The logs will aid in understanding and improving algorithm performance.

feat(geneticAlgorithm): add dataset index to log
Add the active dataset index to the logbook and table.
- Include dataset index to track dataset rotation. - Add print statement to debug dataset rotation. - Update logbook header to display dataset index.

perf(geneticAlgorithm): increase dataset rotation frequency
Increase dataset rotation frequency to improve performance.
- Modify dataset_rotation_freq from 3 to 10. - Improve algorithm exploration.

```text feat(geneticAlgorithm): add plotting and improve evaluation
- Add `mplcursors` for interactive plots - Implement `plotEvo.py` for visualizing GA performance - Fix dataset rotation and objective evaluation ```

feat(geneticAlgorithm): Increase dataset window
Extends the time window for each dataset.
- Increases the `days` parameter from 93 to 270 for each dataset. - Shifts the `start` dates to provide a continuous historical window. - Improves the model training with expanded data range.

feat(geneticAlgorithm): extend dataset window

feat(geneticAlgorithm): improve logging and error handling
- Enhance generation logging with invalid individual count - Add try-except to `ga.run` to catch and raise exceptions - Fixes logging of number of individuals evaluated
The commit improves the robustness and monitoring of the genetic algorithm by providing more detailed logging information and ensuring exceptions are properly handled. The logging now includes the number of invalid individuals, and error handling is improved by re-raising exceptions caught during the `ga.run` execution.

The population size was too small. - Increase population size from 4 to 100. - Improve performance.

feat(paper-trading): Enhance Dow trend strat integration
- Add KianStrat for Dow trend-based trading - Block reentry in paperTrader until signal resets - Improve plotter with DataFrame validation and error handling
This commit introduces the KianStrat, which leverages Dow trend analysis for paper trading. It prevents multiple entries on sustained signals, improves chart plotting robustness and the addition of trendlines.

feat(paper-trading): Enhance Dow trend strat integration
- Add KianStrat for Dow trend trading - Block reentry until signal resets - Improve plotter robustness
This commit introduces KianStrat, leveraging Dow trend analysis for paper trading. Prevents multiple entries, improves chart plotting and trendline addition.

feat(kianStrat): refine entry conditions for Dow trend
Refine buy/sell conditions based on peaks/valleys.
- Modify buy condition: close price must exceed peak price. - Modify sell condition: close price must be below valley price.
This improves the KianStrat's entry logic.

feat(kianStrat): add trend data to evaluate
add trend info, peaks, and valleys as optional params to the evaluate function to prevent recomputation.
- Allow passing pre-computed trend data - Improve performance by avoiding redundant calculations - Ensure backward compatibility

feat(trading): enable order requests from strategies
- Allow strategies to return order requests instead of confidence values. - Add symbol handling for order requests in the paper trader. - Update base trading data model to include optional symbol.

feat(trading): enable order requests from strategies
- Allow strategies to return order requests. - Add symbol handling for order requests. - Update trading data model to include symbol.

feat(dow): improve trend change time check
The trend change logic in dow.py was not working as intended. This commit fixes a type comparison issue.
- Corrects time delta comparison in trend detection. - Fixes `.idea/workspace.xml` to reflect recent changes.

feat(paperTrader): Log confidence value
Log the confidence value during order evaluation for debugging.

fix(paper-trade): disable start on new candle
Disable `start_on_new_candle` for immediate execution.
- Allow paper trading to start immediately upon script execution. - Avoid delay waiting for the next candle.
This change provides a better user experience for backtesting scenarios.
